Simulate irregular streams from fixed impulse-response functions

simulate_cdr.Rd

Creates irregular impulse and response times. Predictor columns are sample-orthogonal and standardized, and responses are generated by the additive convolution of the supplied ground-truth IRFs plus Gaussian noise.

Usage

simulate_cdr(
  irfs,
  n_impulses = 500,
  n_responses = 600,
  duration = 60,
  window = 2,
  intercept = 0,
  noise_sd = 1,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

irfs

Named non-empty list of functions. One-argument functions define linear lag IRFs; two-argument functions of lag and predictor value define nonlinear tensor IRFs.

n_impulses

Number of impulses.

n_responses

Number of responses.

duration

Duration of the simulated series.

window

Maximum causal lag included in the convolution.

intercept

Response intercept.

noise_sd

Gaussian response noise standard deviation.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A list containing impulse and response data, IRFs, noiseless components, and simulation settings.
